sentences.en: You may depend upon it that the story is exaggerated.
sentences.zh: 你可别信那故事，肯定会夸大其词。

sentences.en: I've told you a million times that you shouldn't exaggerate.
sentences.zh: 我已经跟你说过无数遍了，不要夸张。

sentences.en: It is impossible to exaggerate the importance of education.
sentences.zh: 教育的重要性怎么强调都不为过。

senses.zh: (使)扩大, (使)增加 - 夸大, 夸张
